title: Weakly associated points of a tensor product with a pulled back sheaf in the finite type case
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma generalises the weak Bourbaki statement to a morphism only locally of finite type: for a finite type sheaf F flat at x over S, the point x is weakly associated to F tensor the pullback of G exactly when s is weakly associated to G and x is associated to the fibre of F (statement lines 3983-3998, tag 05IH). The proof is a three stage reduction with real content: a local closed immersion into an affine space over the base making the morphism of finite presentation, then the local structure proposition together with the etale up and down lemma to make the sheaf of finite presentation and flat, and finally the affine reduction to the finite presentation statement. The two reduction steps are the substance, so the claim is H2.
